d: Donald Trump rolls out the red carpet for Chinese President Xi Jinping as the U.S.-China summit begins in Washington. Xi Jinping arrives in the United States for a three-day state visit, with Trump personally welcoming him at Joint Base Andrews in a rare diplomatic gesture. Trump welcomed Xi with military honours, fighter jet flyover and a B-1 bomber flypast. But behind the ceremony, Trump and Xi face major issues including U.S.-China trade, tariffs, artificial intelligence, technology, rare earths, global security and tensions over Iran.
